title: Grateful Dead Live at Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1981-05-12
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz)> KORG AudioGate 4 > Adobe Audition CC 2020 > TLH flac2496
source: Bob Wagner's Master (FOB) Audience Cassette; Nakamichi CM700 mics > Sony TC-D5M

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience field recording that captures a funky Shakedown Street set and fire‑filled Sugar Magnolia, with crystal‑clear sound for thunderous listening.
ai_review.review: The tape is praised as a very high‑quality audience recording that holds up under loud volumes, thanks to the skill of Wagner, Clugston, and Miller. Musically the show shines with a funky Shakedown Street, beautiful Ship of Fools, powerful Drums, an on‑fire Sugar Magnolia, and a heartfelt He’s Gone dedication to Bob Marley.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed review is overwhelmingly positive about both performance and recording; weighting gives a high combined score but limited data lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Field recording praised for clarity, balance, and ability to handle thunderous volume; no noted drop‑outs or muffiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Positive flow throughout both sets, highlighted by funky jams and strong second‑set energy.

band_member_comments.Drums: Reviewer loves the Drums segment, noting its power.
